user.title: Connect to Solar of Things over Bluetooth
user.description: The AES key is optional. Leave it blank to add the RWB1 using its real FEE7/FED5/FED6 GATT connection. After setup, Home Assistant will run a captured read-only Solar of Things probe and report whether the application layer replies. Decoded inverter telemetry still requires the application AES key until automatic credential retrieval is implemented. Close Solar of Things Proximal Monitoring while testing because the logger may allow only one active BLE client.

error.cannot_connect: Could not establish the expected RWB1 GATT connection. Confirm Bluetooth range and close Proximal Monitoring in the phone app.
error.invalid_aes_key: The BLE AES key must be exactly 32 hexadecimal characters.

abort.already_configured: This Bluetooth device is already configured.
